sections.title: API Keys
sections.content: API Keys covers obtaining and managing client credentials (client ID and client secret) for a Developer Connect application. These credentials are used with OAuth 2.0 to request access tokens for the Encompass APIs. Includes guidance on creating apps, rotating secrets, and scoping keys to the correct instance and environment.

sections.title: Authorization
sections.content: Authorization describes the OAuth 2.0 flows for Encompass APIs, including the authorization code grant and client credentials grant. Covers requesting bearer access tokens, scopes, token expiration and refresh, and token revocation. Access tokens are passed in the Authorization: Bearer header on every API call.

Part 2Say Goodbye to Polling in the Encompass Lending Platform - Part 1MY ACCOUNTAPI KeySAML SSOLender MFAUser ManagementSuggest EditsICE Mortgage Technology provides a programmatic way of handling the entire lifecycle of user identities within Encompass and other supported ICE Mortgage Technology products. By Leveraging APIs for user management, Lenders can integrate ICE Mortgage Technology product users with centralized IDPs ensuring secure and efficient user handling across different enterprise solutions. At ICE, user management can be handled either at the application level via admin UI or application APIs (available for Encompass product) or using the ICE Mortgage Technology System for Cross-Domain Identity Management (SCIM) interface for centralized user management and cross-domain SSO experience for supported ICE Mortgage Technology Products. For details on the use cases supported for each channel of automated user provisioning, please see the Supported Use Cases and Solutions Matrix. The following ICE Mortgage Technology products currently support user provisioning via the ICE Mortgage Technology SCIM Interface. ICE Mortgage Technology ProductSCIM SupportEncompass on the Web and Encompass Desktop appYesDDA Analyzers (support for cross-domain sso)Yes For information on user management using the SCIM Interface, please see the SCIM User Provisioning section of this guide. For information on user management using the Encompass V3 User APIS (available with the 24.2 release version of Encompass) please see the V3 Internal Users APIs. sections.title: Loan Manufacturing
sections.content: Loan Manufacturing describes end-to-end loan lifecycle workflows: creating loans, reading and updating loan data and fields, ordering services, moving loans through processing and underwriting, and closing. This is the core set of APIs for building and updating loan files programmatically.

Comments for a SubtaskgetAdd a Comment to a SubtaskpostTask PipelineGet Task PipelinegetLoan PipelineUse the Pipeline API to search for loans and loan fields on the Pipeline. To perform a search, use V1 Loan Pipeline and enter simple search criteria to refine results. Pagination There may be times when your application needs to retrieve a long list of loans from the server but you cannot afford to pull all of these items to the client because of the negative performance impact. To help alleviate this problem, the Pipeline API supports cursor-based pagination. Cursor-based pagination separates results into pages. The size of the pages are defined by the start and limit parameters of the cursor (x-cursor ID). By using cursors you can dramatically improve the performance of your application when handling large data sets. Filter Criteria You can fine-tune results by defining filter criteria. The filter terms you can query against are: CanonicalName, Value, MatchType, Terms, Operator, Precision, and Include. canonicalName Canonical names are field definitions for all of the Encompass Pipeline fields. Every Pipeline field that can be queried has a canonical name with the format Source.Field. You can use the Source portion when there are multiple sources of data in a single query, for example, when querying recently completed loans for borrowers or business contacts. A canonicalName attribute must be provided when using the filter parameter. The API supports the following data sources: • Loan – The source for all fields when performing a query against the Loans database. • Field – The source for field data stored in the Reporting Database. Use V1 Get Pipeline Canonical Names to return a list of accepted canonical field names. Considerations Pipeline API Data Refresh Rate The Pipeline API sources its data from the Encompass Reporting Database (RDB). The RDB is updated asynchronously so be aware that not all Saves and Updates to loans in Encompass will update the RDB immediately. For cursor-based queries, the data returned is from a snapshot captured at the creation of the cursor. Performance Increase with Admin Persona Performing a pipeline search does not require Administrator persona access. However, there is a significant performance increase when the search request is made by an admin user.Updated 2 months ago Did this page help you?YesNoUpdated 2 months ago Did this page help you?YesNoTable of Contents Pagination Filter Criteria canonicalName Considerations

sections.title: Product and Pricing
sections.content: Product and Pricing (PPE) integration covers rate sheets, product eligibility, pricing scenarios, and rate lock requests through the Encompass product and pricing APIs.

sections.title: Compliance
sections.content: Compliance covers regulatory workflows such as TRID, disclosures, audit trails, and reporting through the Encompass APIs, helping integrations stay aligned with lending regulations.

sections.title: Documents
sections.content: Documents covers eFolder and document management: generating documents, uploading and retrieving files, attaching documents to loans, and managing document metadata and attachments.

sections.title: Loan Data Extracts
sections.content: Loan Data Extracts covers extracting loan data in bulk for reporting and analytics, including access to loan fields via the loan data dictionary for downstream data warehousing.

sections.title: Loan Folders
sections.content: Loan Folders covers working with loan folders to organize and route loans within Encompass, including listing folders and moving loans between them.

sections.title: Compliance Calendar Date Calculator API
sections.content: The Compliance Calendar Date Calculator API calculates compliance-related dates such as business days and disclosure timelines, accounting for holidays and regulatory rules.

sections.title: Encompass SDK to API Migration
sections.content: Encompass SDK to API Migration provides guidance for moving legacy Encompass SDK integrations to the modern REST APIs, including mapping SDK operations to equivalent API endpoints.

sections.title: EFC Webhook
sections.content: EFC Webhook covers configuring Encompass event notifications (webhooks) to receive real-time callbacks when loans and resources change, including subscribing to events and validating webhook payloads.

sections.title: Encompass Loan Data Dictionary
sections.content: The Encompass Loan Data Dictionary is the reference of loan field IDs and canonical field names used across the APIs. Use it to map calculator inputs and integration fields to the correct Encompass field IDs.

sections.title: Encompass TPO Connect
sections.content: Encompass TPO Connect covers third-party originator (TPO) integration patterns, enabling brokers and correspondents to submit and manage loans through TPO Connect.

sections.title: Encompass Customization
sections.content: Encompass Customization covers custom fields, custom forms, and business rules that affect integrations, including how custom field IDs surface through the APIs.

sections.title: ICE PPE Partner
sections.content: ICE PPE Partner covers integrating as an ICE Product and Pricing Engine partner, exposing pricing and eligibility to Encompass users.

sections.title: Point of Sale Integration
sections.content: Point of Sale Integration covers connecting point-of-sale (POS) systems to Encompass to originate and synchronize loan data from the borrower-facing application.

sections.title: Send Encompass Docs
sections.content: Send Encompass Docs covers sending and attaching documents to the Encompass eFolder from an external system.

sections.title: Working with Enhanced Conditions
sections.content: Working with Enhanced Conditions covers managing underwriting enhanced conditions through the APIs, including creating, updating, and clearing conditions on a loan.

sections.title: Best Practices
sections.content: Best Practices covers recommended patterns for performance, security, error handling, pagination, and rate limiting when building Encompass integrations, including handling 429 rate-limit responses with backoff.

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.content: Frequently Asked Questions answers common questions about Developer Connect access, credentials, tokens, environments, and API behavior.
